description.p: Panero is an independent fork of Krusader. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by KDE or the Krusader maintainers.
It keeps Krusader's file management engine and adds a modernised appearance and a workflow familiar to Total Commander users:

ul.li: Two independent panels with tabs, breadcrumbs, drive selector and a folder tree
Persistent marks separate from the keyboard cursor; right-click marks, holding the right button opens the context menu
Compact, adjustable rows with alternating backgrounds and an Extension column
Archive handling, remote protocols, search, synchronizer and internal viewer/editor from Krusader

description.p: Windows: cloud folders of OneDrive, Google Drive and Dropbox in the sidebar without downloading while browsing, Explorer's offline actions, folder icons fixed and an installer. Drive buttons with letter or icon only and a Network button. Linux: a Windows 11 icon theme option.
Drive buttons above each panel, a built-in Multi-Rename (Ctrl+M) with Total Commander's patterns, the same sort arrows everywhere, and a Windows version built from the same code.
Fixes a freeze while browsing cloud drives when rclone was busy, for example while another program opened files from the drive. Fewer requests to Google Drive and OneDrive.

Smooth cloud browsing: the whole folder list is read in the background, folders never freeze Panero, changes appear by themselves. Optional own Google client ID for a fast Google Drive, folder badges, renaming cloud drives, browsing stops at the drive's top folder.
Much faster browsing of cloud drives, Make Available Offline and Free Up Space for files and folders, Google Docs open in the browser, progress windows while adding and connecting a cloud drive.
OneDrive sign-in works for personal accounts where Microsoft lists a drive that cannot be opened ("ObjectHandle is Invalid"): Panero uses the account's main drive.
Fixes the OneDrive sign-in that stayed at "Waiting for the sign-in to finish", asks OneDrive only for the access shown, and shows the Google Drive and OneDrive icons.
Safe cloud sign-in: Panero's own up-to-date rclone, sign-ins stored encrypted and unlocked by the desktop keyring, real sign-out at the provider, and offline files for cloud drives.
Cloud drives and servers in the sidebar, Quick Settings with icon and folder colour options, progress in the panel, Copy Path and Open Terminal Here, and many fixes.
Modern look with a menu button, one icon-only toolbar, reliable folder tree, zoom between Details and Thumbnails, folder size on Space, active panel colour and selection style options.
Sidebar and toolbar refinements: Trash menu, Details/Thumbnails toggle, resizable pins and folder tree, drag folders to pin.
First preview release, based on Krusader 2.8.1.
